::: {.callout-note}
This Notebook was used to run the full simulation for the case study discussed in the manuscript. The simulation takes more than 1 hour to run on a Mac Book Pro (13-inch, M1, 2020) with 16 GB memory.
:::

## Simulation functions

```{r}
#| echo: true
simulate <- function(n_subjects = 40, n_items = 24, #just starting point
  b_0 = 0.85,  # intercept: log-odds of agreeing in the reference cell (No-XAI, AI incorrect)
  b_ai = 1.5,  # effect of AI being correct
  b_concise = 0.0, # Concise vs No-XAI (explanation-format main effect)
  b_irac = 0.0,      # IRAC vs No-XAI
  b_expl = 0.0,      # effect of explanation correctness
  b_ai_expl = 0.0,   # ai_correct x expl_correct (alignment effect)
  sd_u0s = 0.5, sd_u0i = 0.5, ...) # moderate amount of variation between subjects and between items ( these are somehow my softest assumption)
  {
    require(dplyr)
    require(faux)
    # simulate design
    dat <- add_random(subject = n_subjects, item = n_items) %>%
      # 3-level condition, within-subject, equal split
      add_within("subject", condition = c("noxai", "concise", "irac")) %>%
      # AI advice correct/incorrect, 70/30 per your design
      mutate(ai_correct = rbinom(n(), 1, prob = 0.7)) %>%
      # explanation correctness: only defined when an explanation is shown
      mutate(expl_correct = if_else(condition == "noxai", 0L,
                                      rbinom(n(), 1L, prob = 0.5))) %>% # an explanation is shown, it's 50/50 correct vs incorrect. --> confirmed after annotation 
      mutate(concise = if_else(condition == "concise", 1L, 0L),
       irac    = if_else(condition == "irac",    1L, 0L)) %>%
      # add random effects
      add_ranef("subject", u0s = sd_u0s) %>%
      add_ranef("item", u0i = sd_u0i) %>%
      # compute dependent variable
      mutate(
        linpred = 
          b_0 + u0s + u0i+
          b_ai * ai_correct +
          b_concise * concise +
          b_irac * irac +
          b_expl * expl_correct +
          b_ai_expl * ai_correct * expl_correct) %>%
      mutate(y_prob = plogis(linpred)) %>%
      mutate(y_bin = rbinom(n = n(), size = 1, prob = y_prob))
    dat
  }
```
# added by safeyah
```{r}
library(lme4)

# one fake dataset
dat <- simulate(n_subjects = 40, n_items = 24)

# fit the analysis GLMM
m <- glmer(
  y_bin ~ ai_correct + concise + irac + expl_correct +
          ai_correct:expl_correct +
          (1 | subject) + (1 | item),
  data = dat,
  family = binomial
)

summary(m)
```

```{r}
#| echo: true
sim_and_analyse <- function(
  formula_chr = "y_bin ~ ai_correct + concise + irac + expl_correct + ai_correct:expl_correct + (1|subject) + (1|item)",
  contrasts = c(
    # Irac vs noxai
    "b4 = b1", "b2 = b1", "b9 = b6", "b7 = b6", 
    # concise vs noxai
    "b5 = b1", "b3 = b1", "b10 = b6", "b8 = b6"), ...){ # Not sure how to map it to my research questions
  require(lme4)
  require(marginaleffects)
  require(tidyr)
  # simulate data
  dat <- simulate(...)
  # fit model
  model <- glmer(as.formula(formula_chr), data = dat, family = "binomial")
  #compute contrasts
  
  # expand_grid(ai_correct = 0:1, expl_correct = 0:1, concise = 0:1, irac = 0:1)
  contr_df <- expand_grid(ai_correct = 0:1, expl_correct = 0:1, concise = 0:1, irac = 0:1) %>% 
    filter(!(concise == 1 & irac == 1)) %>%    # not both formats in the same row
    filter(!(concise == 0 & irac == 0 & expl_correct == 1))     # No-XAI has no explanation
  predictions(model, newdata = contr_df, type = "response", re.form = NA) %>%
    hypotheses(hypothesis = contrasts, equivalence = c(0, 0)) %>%
    data.frame()
}
```

## Run simulation

```{r}
#| echo: true
library(tidyverse)
library(future)
library(furrr)
  
plan("multisession", workers = 6)
set.seed(2)
  
sim_result <- crossing(
  rep = 1:100,
  n_subjects = c(20, 30, 40, 50), 
  n_items = c(12, 18, 24, 30)
) %>%
  mutate(res = future_pmap(., sim_and_analyse, 
    .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE))) %>%
  unnest(col = res)
```
## Save results file to be used in the manuscript

```{r}
#| echo: true
saveRDS(sim_result, file = "results.rds")
```
